facts.idle_at_peak_top: q62 14,079 ops idle at peak, 73 runs
facts.full_width_runs: 122 runs, 0 with no idle value; 3 release(s) cover the rest (exact)

full_width_runs.verdict: every full-width run has an idle value; 3 release(s) cover all 122 (exact): necessary for Q - 1, not sufficient

hitting_set.method: greedy, equal to the packing lower bound (optimal)

static.basis: CCX whose controls hold the same wire versions as an earlier CCX

exact.basis: CCX whose AND is equal on every legal x in every outcome model

definitions.account: a wire; register wires grouped by register (numbered families folded: S0..S69 -> S*)
definitions.entry: an op touching the account: toffoli (CCX/CSWAP target), data (CX/X/SWAP target), phase (Z/CZ/CCZ/Z_POW), control, settle (R/HMR)
definitions.value: one lifetime of a non-register wire (the width verb's interval): opened at its first touch after a reset, closed at an unconditional R/HMR or at its last touch
definitions.contra: value closed at its last touch: erased by unitary uncompute (presumed statically; checked exactly for invsqrt)
definitions.accrual: value closed by HMR whose record later conditions fix-ups: a phase liability until the last one
definitions.dead-tail: value closed by R, or by HMR whose record nothing reads
definitions.liability: one HMR record, open from the HMR to the last op it (or a bit derived from it) conditions
definitions.trial balance: at each stage cut: values open across the cut, liabilities open across it, live width
definitions.capital: qubit-ops × rate / ops: T-eq of width used; charged = certified width × rate
definitions.idle at peak: ops at full width strictly inside a value's idle gaps (no entry on the wire); the aged list is ranked by it, then by the longest idle gap (idle)
definitions.idle capital: idle_capital_teq = longest idle gap × rate / ops. Additive bookkeeping, NOT a saving: width is a maximum, so Q falls only if every full-width run is covered by a release
definitions.full-width run: a maximal op range at the certified width; a value covers it when one of its idle gaps holds the whole run (static)
definitions.uncoverable run: a full-width run no scratch value is idle across: no release can narrow it, so Q cannot fall by releases alone
definitions.hitting set: fewest release candidates (values) covering every coverable full-width run, unit cost each; necessary for Q - 1, not sufficient (the release and any recompute must fit below the peak)
definitions.paying twice: a CCX computing the same AND as an earlier one (exact: equal on every x; static: same wire versions)
